positions.name: OwnedIntelligenceAsRetainedAsset
positions.frame: what distinguishes intelligence that is owned and kept from intelligence that is merely rented or run on a commodity substrate?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the same categorical ownership distinction at principle-level conviction (per the conviction dimension's mint spanning both), in the same plain-spoken, aphoristic register (register dimension's AphoristicTechnicalMaxim mint), reframing what is fungible (substrate, rented access) against what is proprietary and retained (perspective, owned intelligence) — a market-pricing relational stance (relational dimension) delivered as rational persuasion via reclassification (power dimension's CommodityAssetReframe mint) and grounded in autonomy/self-enhancement values (value dimension's OwnershipAsValueAxis mint). The two expressions read as one settled, calm-positive thesis rather than two separate claims — src-2 states the general distinction, src-3 supplies its concrete substrate/perspective instantiation — with no internal tension, only elaboration.
